tvs.title-bl-seo: Take a look at our eye micropigmentation photos
tvs.text-bl-seo:
When it comes to permanent eye makeup, keep in mind that the effect will change your appearance for at least 2 years. So, to be happy with the final result, it's essential to look at the eye micropigmentation photos in a particular artist's portfolio. Photos of semi-permanent eye makeup will also help you assess the artist's level of skill. Images of an eyelid tattoo
will show how experienced the artist is and which techniques they use.

By reviewing a portfolio of semi-permanent eye makeup work, you can tell whether the artist is right for you, whether you want to book with them, and whether you'd like a similar eyeliner tattoo. Quality photos reveal a lot and will help you make the right decision.
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
Have you decided to get semi-permanent eye makeup?

It's an excellent choice, and we're sure you'll be pleased with the result. In fact, eye micropigmentation gives you not only self-confidence, but also:

  • it transforms your look, making your eyes appear bigger and your lashes longer;
  • it helps visually change the shape of your eyes. For example, if your eyes are set too close together, a beautiful contour of optimal shape and thickness can make them appear farther apart. Or it can make your eyes look bigger;
  • it helps camouflage any imperfections in the tattooed area: small scars, droopy eyelids, expression lines, pigmentation spots, vitiligo, etc.;
  • it cuts down your makeup time – especially if you find it hard to draw straight, even lines.

So all you need to do is look at eye tattoo photos and choose the right technique. There are 3 main styles to choose from: upper/lower lash line enhancement, classic eyeliner and eyeliner with shading. When choosing a semi-permanent eye makeup technique, weigh the pros and cons of each one to see exactly which suits you best. You can always consult the artist before the procedure to choose the technique. The artist will take into account the shape of your face and eyes, as well as your preferences. Browse our artists' portfolios and book your eye micropigmentation at LBar. We'll be happy to help you look even more beautiful!
